name: Chrome Mox
oracle_text:
Imprint — When this artifact enters, you may exile a nonartifact, nonland card from your hand.
{T}: Add one mana of any of the exiled card's colors.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any of the exiled card's colors.

needs.what: a fifth spelling of which colors an `add_mana` offers, reading the printed COLORS OF A CARD rather than the mana a permanent could produce -- e.g. `{"op": "add_mana", "colors_of": {"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"}}`. The loader's mana fold would record the selector and advertise the five-color superset the way `reflecting` already does (so `solver_taps` and `offerable_mana_ability` still see a mana source), and `costs.mana_options_of` would narrow the options at activation to the distinct colors printed on the matched card -- a colorless or absent card offering nothing, exactly as an Exotic Orchard facing no lands does. An accompanying `value_keys` leaf reading an object's colors would serve the same family of cards (Mox Amber's "any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control").
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_mana` accepts exactly four ways of naming its colors and the loader rejects any other (`effects.py`: "add_mana needs 'mana' (or 'reflecting', or 'in_commander_identity', or 'split')"). `mana` is a literal symbol string, so it cannot vary with what was imprinted -- the packet's `starting_point`, a `choose_mode` over all five `add_mana`s, is precisely the approximation this record refuses: it taps for any color with nothing imprinted at all. `reflecting` takes a selector but asks each matched object's own mana ABILITIES what they could produce (`costs.mana_options_of` iterates `abilities_of` and skips anything that is not `is_mana_ability`); the imprinted card is a nonartifact, nonland card sitting in exile with no mana abilities, so `{"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"}` there would yield an empty color set and the Mox would tap for nothing. `in_commander_identity` asks the command zone, a different question with a different answer. `mana` as a mapping is `mana_chosen_color`, which reads the permanent's `chosen_color` set by the `choose_color` op -- but Chrome Mox never says "choose a color", so imprinting a mono-blue card and then adding {R} would be a strictly better card than the printed one. No `value_keys` or `selector_keys` leaf reads the colors of an object either (`colors` is a selector FILTER, and `colors_of_mana_spent` and `commander_color_identity` answer other questions), so there is nothing to feed such an option even if one existed.
needs.note: The first printed line needs nothing new: "Imprint — When this artifact enters, you may exile a nonartifact, nonland card from your hand." is a `self_enters` trigger wrapping `may` around `{"op": "exile", "link": "self", "objects": {"zone": "hand", "controller": "you", "count": 1, "not_types": ["Artifact", "Land"]}}`, the shape Isochron Scepter and Soul Foundry already ship. Only the mana ability is blocked, so this card should load the moment the mana half exists.
